declarations.name: AuiKbd

inputs.name: hotkey
inputs.description: Shortcut in matchesHotkey syntax, such as 'Mod+Shift+K'; 'Plus' is the + key.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: Apple shows Command for Mod and modifier symbols; other shows Ctrl and '+' separators; auto detects.

accessibility.pattern: Keyboard input markup: a kbd element for the combination with one nested kbd per key (HTML kbd semantics).

limitations: One combination per instance; for a sequence (G then I) use one Kbd per step.
Platform detection uses the user-agent string (auto); set platform to override.
